fields.Name: Predictive Studio Gates — Monitoring (statistical)
fields.Description: The statistical gates of model serving and monitoring: G3.4 (over 400 W2-noise seeds at most 28 runs reach Published through the lifecycle gate, and every other run stores its outcome with its reason); G6.6 (at most 28 of 400 T4 no-drift replays alarm at q(12)) and G6.8 (EngagementZ flagged within 1 period of the D2 shift in at least 372 of 400 seeds, mean FDP at most 0.05), each replaying the n400 seeds through monitor procedure M on the truth sidecar. Each member row's MaxExecutionTimeMS is its measured full-count duration plus 50%, and the suite runs and passes once on the final head before merge. Needs MJAPI (STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT set, PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_SIDECAR_URL at the truth sidecar), the truth sidecar running and `pnpm run truth:provision` done; the mj test process needs STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT too. Run with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Monitoring (statistical)"
